**One reading the card asked for, and it did not come out the way the card hoped — flagged rather than buried.**

The PR is self-testing in principle, and all six `Test Core` shards on it went green. But **this PR un-censors nothing**, and no shard-timing number should be taken from it. `Test Core (5/6)` completed in 54s (02:05:18Z to 02:06:12Z) and its own log says why:

```
shard 5/6: 0/0 items (0 of them file-level slices of 0 package(s)), 0.0s predicted
No packages on this shard — nothing to test.
No test log — the test step did not get far enough to produce one.
Attested: test-5-of-6 ran to completion with every step green
```

A `.github/workflows/**`-only diff affects zero packages, so the partitioner scheduled zero items onto every shard. The 54s is fixed per-shard overhead — checkout, pnpm/Turbo cache restore, install, attestation — and nothing else. Reporting it as shard 5's duration would be the same category error the card is about: a reading of the harness rather than of the shard.

So the raise is still the instrument, but it only fires on a PR whose diff actually schedules packages onto shard 5. **The first uncensored shard-5 duration will come from the next such PR to run against this workflow** — that is where the rebalance work should take its input, and it is the reason this raise wants to stay in place until then.

CI state at report time: `Test Core` (aggregate), `Lint & Repo Gates`, three `Type Check` legs, `Console Pin Gate`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Build Docs` and `Dogfood Verify CLI` were still `in_progress`. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Build Core`, all six `Test Core (N/6)` shards and all three `Dogfood Regression Gate (N/3)` shards had concluded success. Nothing red at report time. Convergence is the PM's read, not mine.
